key_stat.context: WD-40 a connu une hausse de 100% de certains coûts d'approvisionnement en raison de la guerre en Iran

hot_topic.subject: Ruptures d'approvisionnement
hot_topic.why_it_matters: Les acheteurs doivent être prêts à gérer les risques liés aux ruptures d'approvisionnement pour maintenir la continuité de leur chaîne d'approvisionnement

post_angles.hook: Comment les entreprises peuvent-elles atténuer les risques liés aux ruptures d'approvisionnement ?
Les dernières nominations dans les équipes d'approvisionnement de Best Buy et de JM Smucker révèlent une tendance vers une gestion plus stratégique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement

raw_articles.title: Best Buy names fulfillment, operations chief
raw_articles.summary: Duane Scarboro is responsible for sourcing, supply chain, fulfillment, delivery and service in the new role, which went into effect last week.

raw_articles.title: WD-40 hit with 100% spike in some sourcing costs from Iran war
raw_articles.summary: The maintenance and household products maker said effects from the conflict strained its supply chain last quarter.

raw_articles.title: JM Smucker snags Hershey exec as SVP of operations, supply chain
raw_articles.summary: Douglas Guilherme will step into the role on July 29 with more than 30 years of experience, including stints at the chocolate maker and Procter & Gamble.

raw_articles.title: JBS axes 2040 net-zero goal, citing ‘immense’ execution challenges
raw_articles.summary: The meat giant will no longer aim to achieve net-zero greenhouse emissions across its supply chain by 2040 and has also dropped scope 3 reduction targets.

raw_articles.title: Amazon to temporarily close Florida facility, lay off nearly 500
raw_articles.summary: The Port St. Lucie distribution site will be renovated into a sortable fulfillment center, with operations set to cease Sept. 17, Amazon told Supply Chain Dive.
